column1: # Associative-commutative EPathMap exact-key matching: decoded-entry control versus canonical-byte PathMap algebra.
# Benchmark harness: 48e6f7d3c. Byte-native treatment: 92240a452. Final moving-zipper treatment: 03685f4c7.
# Host: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 5975WX, 32 physical cores, SMT disabled; CPU 8 pinned; performance governor; no competing Cargo or rustc process at preflight.
# Command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=8G -p MemorySwapMax=0 taskset -c 8 cargo bench -p rholang --bench epathmap_ac_exact

# Fixture: exact EPathMap set and map patterns at 16, 256, and 4,096 entries plus a wildcard remainder, which forces the production general PathMachine. Fixture construction and cloning are outside the timed interval.
# Criterion: 82 post-warm-up samples per arm/cell; 2 s warm-up; 5 s requested measurement interval; 99% confidence; 1% significance.
# Primary pgmcp experiment/hypothesis: 233, cardinality 256, lower mean latency is better. All six final-treatment comparisons against the original decoded control are accepted with p << 0.01.

# Protocol note: pgmcp later recommended 8,030 samples per arm for the observed effect/variance, despite accepting the preregistered 82-sample run. Treat these as decisive engineering measurements under the locked protocol, not as satisfaction of the later power recommendation.

# Provenance note: Criterion rotated the first treatment into its on-disk `base` before the final run. A subsequently synthesized combined metric consequently duplicated treatment data in both arms and is invalid. It is excluded. The per-cell control samples were recorded in pgmcp before rotation and are the sole decision controls below.

# Correctness: models EPathMap algebra 8/8; Rholang spatial EPathMap 6/6; matcher legacy 50/50; fusion differential 6/6; replay equivalence 1/1; live COMM 5/5; release models+rholang 2,013/2,013 with 11 skipped under MemoryMax=12G and zero swap.
